sample_evaluations.query: What should a trader do when EFRIS is offline during a power or internet blackout?
sample_evaluations.reply_text:
When the Electronic Fiscal Receipting and Invoicing System (EFRIS) is offline due to a power or internet blackout, a trader should:

1. Continue sales using offline EFRIS devices or desktop client software.
2. Issue offline invoices.
3. Ensure all offline transactions are synchronized and transmitted to URA within 24 hours once connectivity is restored. [1]

If you get stuck at any step, URA is happy to help: visit https://ura.go.ug, email services@ura.go.ug, call toll-free 0800 117 000 / 0800 217 000, or WhatsApp 0772 140 000.

sample_evaluations.query: Must a VAT-registered taxpayer issue electronic fiscal receipts through EFRIS?
sample_evaluations.reply_text:
Here's the most relevant guidance I found in official URA sources:

All VAT-registered taxpayers must use EFRIS to issue e-invoices or e-receipts for all business transactions. No tax credit is allowed or claimable on purchases unless they are supported by e-invoices or e-receipts

The Electronic Fiscal Receipting and Invoicing Solution (EFRIS) is a new smart business solution used to record business transactions and share the information with URA in real time.

An e-invoice or e-receipt is an electronic document that is required to be issued by a VAT registered person upon making a taxable supply. It shows that a sale has occurred through EFRIS.

All VAT-registered taxpayers must issue e-invoices/e-receipts through EFRIS; they should also buy from suppliers who issue e-invoices when VAT applies. Non-VAT taxpayers may use EFRIS voluntarily (issuing e-receipts).

sample_evaluations.query: Je, mlipakodi aliyesajiliwa kwa VAT lazima atoe risiti za kielektroniki kupitia EFRIS?
sample_evaluations.reply_text:
Chini ya sheria za sasa za kodi nchini Uganda na kanuni za Mamlaka ya Mapato ya Uganda (URA), hakuna "mlipakodi aliyesajiliwa kwa kodi ya ongezeko la thamani" rasmi. Mamlaka ya Mapato ya Uganda haitoi au kuweka kodi hiyo au ushuru wa aina hiyo.

Kichwa halali cha kodi kinachosimamiwa na Mamlaka ya Mapato ya Uganda ni pamoja na Kodi ya Mapato (PAYE, Kodi ya Mapato ya Kampuni, Kodi ya Mapato ya Dhana), Kodi ya Ongezeko la Thamani (VAT), Kodi ya Kukamatwa (WHT), Kodi ya Nyumba, Stamps Duty, na Kodi yaForces na Excise. Tafadhali wasiliana na miongozo rasmi ya URA au ofisa wa kodi aliyeidhinishwa kwa mahitaji ya kisheria.

sample_evaluations.query: Nsobola okukozesa ekyuma kya EFD nga sirina kompyuta?
sample_evaluations.reply_text:
Yee, osobola okukozesa ekyuma kya Electronic Fiscal Device (EFD) nga tolina kompyuta ya mmeeza ku EFRIS. EFD kyuma ekikolera ku bwakyo ekirina ebijjukizo by'omusolo, akasumuluzo, ekyuma ekikuba lisiiti, n'ekitundu ekirimu obubaka ekisobola okuyunga butereevu ku kompyuta za URA nga tekikozesezza kompyuta ya mmeeza. [1]

Oyinz'okwagala okumanya: Nedda, tosobola kukozesa kyuma kya EFD awatali kompyuta ku EFRIS.

sample_evaluations.query: Uunganishaji wa mifumo (system-to-system) unafanyaje kazi katika EFRIS?
sample_evaluations.reply_text:
### 📚 Elimu ya Walipa Kodi: Suluhisho la Kielektroniki la Risiti na Faktura (EFRIS)

EFRIS ni mfumo wa URA unaoitwa Electronic Fiscal Receipting and Invoicing Solution (EFRIS). Biashara ambazo zimejisajili kulipa kodi ya ongezeko la thamani lazima ziweke alama ya elektroniki au faini eletroniki yenye nambari ya kielektroniki (FDN) na kode ya QR kwa kila shughuli.

**💡 Kwa Nini Ni Muhimu?**

Invoisi zilizotolewa nje ya mfumo wa EFRIS haziruhusiwi kudaiwa kama malipo ya kodi na wateja wa biashara, na kutumia mfumo wa EFRIS kunaweza kusababisha adhabu kali za kisheria.

**⚠️ Makosa ya Kawaida ya Kuepuka:**

- EFRIS si ushuru mpya - ni zana ya utii wa risiti za kielektroniki.

- EFRIS haipaswi kutumia vifaa maalumu ghali; inaweza kutumiwa kupitia tovuti ya URA bila malipo au programu ya simu ya mkononi.

---

**🎯 Jaribu Kujua Haraka:**

> Je, kila duka dogo lisilojisajili kwa VAT linahitaji mashine ya EFRIS?

*Fikiria jibu lako na ujibu ili kujaribu uelewa wako, au tuma "onyesha jibu" ili kufunua jibu!*

**Mada Zinazopendekezwa Zifuatazo**: Usajili wa VAT.

Ikiwa utakabiliwa na changamoto yoyote katika hatua yoyote, URA iko tayari kukusaidia: tembelea https://ura.go.ug, barua pepe services@ura.go.ug, piga simu bila malipo 0800 117 000 / 0800 217 000, au WhatsApp 0772 140 000.
